text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"States a clear pro position and gives reasons in the opening paragraph","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It more directly presents an arguable stance and previews why the writer supports driverless cars."},{"evidence":"Uses article details like accidents, gas use, sensors, and LIDAR","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"It grounds the argument in specific information from the source rather than mostly general enthusiasm."},{"evidence":"Explains how sensors alert the driver and improve response time","quality":"reasoning","description":"It more often connects evidence to a claim by showing why the details matter."},{"evidence":"Mentions safety concerns and work zones before arguing the cars are beneficial","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It acknowledges some limits and objections, then responds to them instead of ignoring the other side."},{"evidence":"Has a multi-paragraph structure with introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It is more clearly organized into distinct parts that build the argument step by step."},{"evidence":"Ends by restating benefits and projecting future development","quality":"conclusion","description":"It closes by summarizing the position and reinforcing the overall argument."}]}
